items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We started doing a group called the Timeless Allstars, which was put together by Cedar [Walton] and Harold, Curtis Fuller, Billy, Buster, traveling all over Europe.

ctx.x: Yeah, it’s her e-mail address, Rose’s Poses. Those things last for so long. The story – you can really see how she – where I was trying to depict how she was at that time when we first met and to be able to open the book and see, okay, here it is. This song shows you exactly where she was coming from. It’s nice to be able to see that. We started doing a group called the Timeless Allstars, which was put together by Cedar [Walton] and Harold, Curtis Fuller, Billy, Buster, traveling all over Europe.
Do you remember what year you hooked up with Fantasy Studios and started recording there? It seems like you had a major output with your association there.
